title: quercus ithaburensis subsp. ungeri
intro: Quercus ithaburensis subsp. ungeri, commonly known as the Palestinian oak or Syrian oak, is a plant species native to the Middle East. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its numerous health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer activities. The plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, respiratory problems, and cardiovascular diseases, due to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve antioxidant status, and exhibit antimicrobial effects.
